2608.22994.title: A Physical Response-and-Memory Model for Muon Optimization
2608.22994.paper_summary: Training large language models is costly. How low a loss the same compute can ultimately reach depends on how each step's gradient is converted into a weight update; the rule that performs this conversion is the optimizer. From SGD and AdamW to the recent Muon, effective update rules have mostly been shaped by engineering intuition and then selected on benchmarks. Muon semi-orthogonalizes the momentum matrix before applying the update and has kept breaking records on public training benchmarks; yet why the semi-orthogonalized direction works, and over how long a history the momentum should average, are two questions at present answered mainly by experience. Here we treat the weight matrix during training as a responsive medium with memory and build a physical model for it, in which both questions find answers: the semi-orthogonalized direction is the maximally dissipative response under an output-side safety budget, which explains why it works; momentum is the internal stress accumulated by the medium; how long it should average is set by the relaxation of this stress, and a real medium relaxes on more than one timescale, the simplest form being one fast and one slow. On this basis we propose the Bi-Maxwell optimizer. The framework further yields a testable consequence: gradient directions change fast early in training and more slowly later, so the optimal memory length should grow with training stage; step-by-step measurements of a proxy for it by a read-only probe across 8 independent training trajectories are consistent with this consequence. Replacing the memory kernel alone, from a single timescale to two, brings training to the target loss in noticeably fewer steps on a public large-language-model optimizer benchmark.
2608.22994.paper_summary_zh: 訓練大型語言模型的成本很高。相同計算能達到的損失低度最終取決於每一步的梯度如何轉換為權重更新；執行此轉換的規則是優化器。從SGD和AdamW到最近的Muon，有效的更新規則大多是基於工程直覺形成的，然後在基準測試中進行選擇。Muon在應用更新之前對動量矩陣進行半正交化，並在公共訓練基準上不斷打破紀錄；然而，為什麼半正交化的方向有效，以及動量應該平均多長時間，這兩個問題目前主要依賴經驗來回答。在這裡，我們將訓練過程中的權重矩陣視為一種具有記憶的響應介質，並為其建立一個物理模型，在這個模型中，兩個問題都找到了答案：半正交化的方向是在輸出端安全預算下的最大耗散響應，這解釋了它為什麼有效；動量是介質所累積的內部應力；應該平均多長時間由這種應力的放鬆來決定，而一個真實的介質在不止一個時間尺度上放鬆，最簡單的形式是一個快的和一個慢的。在此基礎上，我們提出了Bi-Maxwell優化器。該框架進一步產生了一個可測試的結果：在訓練初期，梯度方向變化迅速，而在後期變化較慢，因此最佳記憶長度應隨著訓練階段增長；通過一個只讀探針對8條獨立訓練軌跡進行的逐步測量與這一結果是一致的。僅僅將記憶核從單一時間尺度替換為兩個，便使訓練在公共大型語言模型優化器基準上以明顯更少的步驟達到目標損失。
